system.description:
She escaped her father through cleverness. The best move is always the one nobody sees coming.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Once per day, become invisible for 1 minute. Ends only if you attack or cast offensively — not when interacting with objects.
  • Patron's Mark (6th): Once per day, perfectly forge any document, signature, or official seal you have examined for at least 1 minute. The forgery is undetectable without magical means.
  • Patron Feature (12th): Once per day, perfectly impersonate anyone studied for 1 minute — face, voice, mannerisms. Indistinguishable without magic. Lasts 8 hours.
